events.title: Thutmose III defeats a Canaanite coalition at Megiddo
events.description: Pharaoh Thutmose III routed a coalition led by the king of Kadesh at Megiddo, on a date traditionally reckoned to 16 April. His annals give the first detailed account of a battle in recorded history.
events.html: Pharaoh Thutmose III routed a coalition led by the king of Kadesh at Megiddo, on a date traditionally reckoned to 16 April. His annals give the first detailed account of a battle in recorded history.

events.title: The Romans breach the walls of Masada
events.description: After a siege of probably two to three months, Roman forces breached the wall of Masada, the last rebel stronghold of the First Jewish–Roman War, with a battering ram. According to Josephus, its defenders killed themselves rather than surrender.

events.title: Pelagius I becomes pope as the candidate of Justinian I
events.description: Pelagius I became bishop of Rome as the candidate of Emperor Justinian I, a choice not well received in the Western Church. Before his papacy he had opposed Justinian's efforts to condemn the Three Chapters, but later adopted the emperor's position.

events.title: Stefan Dušan is crowned Emperor of the Serbs at Skopje
events.description: Stefan Dušan, King of Serbia since 1331, was crowned Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks at Skopje, founding the Serbian Empire. It became the largest Balkan state of its day but broke apart soon after his death in 1355.

events.title: Jacobite army is crushed at Culloden
events.description: Government troops under the Duke of Cumberland routed Charles Edward Stuart's army near Inverness in under an hour. It was the last pitched battle on British soil and was followed by harsh repression in the Highlands.

events.title: Powers sign the Paris Declaration on maritime law
events.description: Meeting at the Congress of Paris, the great powers agreed to abolish privateering and protect neutral goods at sea. It was the first multilateral treaty codifying the laws of naval warfare.
events.html: Meeting at the Congress of Paris, the great powers agreed to abolish privateering and protect neutral goods at sea. It was the first multilateral treaty codifying the laws of naval warfare.

events.title: Lenin arrives at Petrograd's Finland Station
events.description: Returning from Swiss exile with German help, Vladimir Lenin was greeted by crowds in Petrograd. His call to oppose the Provisional Government set the Bolsheviks on the road to the October Revolution.

events.title: Albert Hofmann experiences the effects of LSD by accident
events.description: Working at Sandoz in Basel, chemist Albert Hofmann absorbed a trace of LSD and felt its effects. Three days later, on 19 April, he took a deliberate dose to test it.
events.html: Working at Sandoz in Basel, chemist Albert Hofmann absorbed a trace of LSD and felt its effects. Three days later, on 19 April, he took a deliberate dose to test it.

events.title: Gunman kills 32 people at Virginia Tech
events.description: A student shot dead 32 people on the campus in Blacksburg, Virginia, before killing himself. It was then the deadliest shooting by a lone gunman in US history and led to reforms of background checks.
